newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's Svila to list shares on OTC market.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's Svila to list shares on OTC market.

text.p: Slovenian textile producer and trading company Svila d.d. will list its shares on the over-the-counter market (OTC) of the Ljubljana Stock Exchange next Friday, the bourse said on Thursday.

The company, based in the northeastern town of Maribor, will list 761,220 shares with a nominal value of 1,000 tolars ($6.99) each, representing 60.25 percent of the company's equity, the bourse said.

Svila, the first of a batch of recently privatised companies to be listed this year, will join 24 such companies which have made their debut on the main or OTC markets of the Ljubljana bourse since the start of last year.
Currently there are 25 shares listed on the main market, while 28 are being traded on the OTC segment of the bourse. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
